title: v0.5.0 release coverage proposal (owner-review preview)
purpose: Owner-review preview of the files proposed for coverage by the eventual v0.5.0 release manifest. Provided so the owner can review scope and per-file SHA-256 before any release action. This is not a manifest and performs no release action.
pinned_commit_note: The SHA-256 values below describe file bytes at this commit (current main at PR-N branch point). PR-N does not modify any listed file, so the pin remains valid on the PR-N branch.
release_action_status: no release performed; no git tag; no signature; no signed manifest; no trust-anchor entry. v0.5.0 disposition: release candidate / pre-release target only.
overclaim_disclaimer: This artifact asserts no release, tag, signature, anchoring, finality, proof, standalone validation, or adoption-proof status for v0.5.0.
boundary_pointer: Standard documentation boundary per docs/CANONICAL_INTERPRETATION_BOUNDARY.md: no runtime authority; does not replace AAOS Genesis Core, x_root, or the sealed Lee_Yu_Cheol origin identity binding.
successor_note: final manifest is generated owner-locally via the prov_k toolchain as a release asset only and is never committed to the tree
deviation_note: Explicit deviation from PR-N instruction section 3: a committed MANIFEST_UNSIGNED_DRAFT artifact would conflict with the docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md manifest-location policy (release-class manifests are never committed) and with the audit invariant 'no release-class manifest anywhere in the tree'. It is therefore redefined as this coverage proposal preview, which deliberately does not imitate the PROV-K manifest schema (no provenance_class field, no signature field, no signing block). HARD STOP 2 (no release-class status token in committed files) is preserved without relaxation.
hash_method: SHA-256 via tools/prov_k (hashlib); independently cross-checked with Windows certutil for 5 samples (canon-kernel.json, verify/verify_canon.py, experiments/RUN_PLAN_002_ARM_B.md, experiments/_incoming/arm_b_01_P1_identity_F_1.json, docs/TRUST_ANCHOR.md); all matched.

included.canon_kernel_and_protocols: v0.5.0 kernel layer (PR #100-#106): machine-readable adoption kernel and the self-anchoring / decision-index / successor-handover / precedent-ledger protocols plus the offline canon self-verification script.
included.run_002_arm_b_plan_and_conclusions: RUN_002 Arm B (PR #107-#113): frozen pre-registration plan and the Phase 1 and Phase 2 conclusion documents (candidate validation / cross-model replication signal only).
included.version_and_trust_anchor_readonly_cover: VERSION_POLICY.md and docs/TRUST_ANCHOR.md are byte-coverage targets so the release seals the version-policy and trust-anchor state at the tagged commit; they are NOT edited by this preview or by PR-N.
included.run_002_arm_b_execution_tooling: RUN_002 Arm B runner / batch-ingest parser / surface scorer / trial-record template / owner runbook (PR #107-#113).
included.run_002_arm_b_evidence: All RUN_002 Arm B evidence records under experiments/_incoming/: Phase 1 (12 trial JSON + prompts + annotations) and Phase 2 (12 trial JSON + probe_00 + annotation package + GPT annotations).

excluded_from_this_preview.whole_repository_remainder: The eventual v0.5.0 release manifest is whole-repository per docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md and the v0.4.1 convention (excluding only .git/__pycache__/.pytest_cache). Files not listed here — including the experiments/_incoming/ drift_* and ladder_* inputs (adoption_drift / compression_ladder / RUN_001, which are not RUN_002 Arm B evidence) and every other repository file — remain covered by that whole-repository build. They are omitted from this preview only to keep it a focused RUN_002 / v0.5.0 review aid, not to exclude them from the release.
